annotations.description: Opponent has no untapped creatures (Pyroclastic Elemental has summoning sickness) and no untapped lands, so there are zero possible blockers. GPT53C Teach passed on attacking with Affectionate Indrik (4/4) and the animated Forest (4/3 with haste from Rampaging Growth), missing 8 free unblocked damage. The animated Forest will cease being a creature at end of turn, so this was the only chance to use it offensively.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed on declaring attackers, dealing 0 damage and wasting the animated 4/3 Forest creature.
annotations.betterLine: Attack with both Affectionate Indrik and the 4/3 Forest for 8 unblocked damage (both have trample from Garruk's Uprising), bringing opponent from 20 to 12.

annotations.description: Declined to block Pyroclastic Elemental 5/4 with Affectionate Indrik 4/4, taking 5 damage. The Pyroclastic Elemental is a major recurring threat (5 power attacker plus {1}{R}{R} ping ability). Trading the 4/4 Indrik (whose ETB has already been used) for the 5/4 Elemental would be a favorable trade in terms of threat removal.
annotations.actionTaken: Did not block, taking 5 damage (20 → 15) and leaving Pyroclastic Elemental alive.
annotations.betterLine: Block with Affectionate Indrik to trade for the Pyroclastic Elemental. While this loses the potential Hunter's Insight target, removing the 5/4 with a repeatable ping ability is likely worth more than preserving a vanilla 4/4 body. The Elemental threatens 5+ damage per turn going forward.

annotations.description: Declined to activate Evolving Wilds while Rampaging Baloths' landfall trigger was on the stack. Activating it would fetch a Forest, triggering a second landfall for an additional 4/4 Beast token, and Garruk's Uprising would draw an extra card for the 4/4 entering. This is pure upside — an extra 4/4 body and a card — and doing it before combat means the token could attack this turn.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without activating Evolving Wilds, getting only one 4/4 Beast token from the original landfall.
annotations.betterLine: Activate Evolving Wilds to fetch a Forest, triggering a second Rampaging Baloths landfall for a second 4/4 Beast token and drawing an extra card from Garruk's Uprising, all before combat.

annotations.description: Evolving Wilds was available to activate, which would fetch a basic land and trigger Rampaging Baloths' landfall ability, creating a free 4/4 Beast token. This costs no mana and doesn't interfere with any other plans (3 untapped Forests remain for Hunter's Insight). Passing here wastes a significant amount of board presence.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without activating Evolving Wilds.
annotations.betterLine: Activate Evolving Wilds to fetch a Forest, triggering Rampaging Baloths' landfall to create an additional 4/4 Beast token before proceeding to attacks.

annotations.description: Declining to activate Evolving Wilds during combat with Rampaging Baloths on the battlefield. Cracking it creates a 4/4 Beast token via landfall at instant speed for free. While the token can't attack this turn, creating it during combat (before blocks) could influence the opponent's blocking decisions and provides an extra body for defense. Even if cracked postcombat, doing it during combat is strictly better for information/pressure purposes.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without activating Evolving Wilds during combat.
annotations.betterLine: Activate Evolving Wilds to fetch a Forest, triggering Rampaging Baloths' landfall to create a 4/4 Beast token before the opponent declares blockers.

annotations.description: Failed to activate Evolving Wilds with Rampaging Baloths and Garruk's Uprising on the battlefield. Activating would fetch a land, triggering Landfall to create a 4/4 Beast token, which in turn triggers Garruk's Uprising to draw a card. This is pure upside - a free 4/4 creature and a card draw for no cost beyond sacrificing the Evolving Wilds.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without activating Evolving Wilds.
annotations.betterLine: Activate Evolving Wilds to fetch a Forest, triggering Rampaging Baloths' Landfall for a 4/4 Beast token and Garruk's Uprising for a card draw.

annotations.description: Cast Goblin Wizardry precombat when nothing on the opponent's board can block (Indrik tapped, all other creatures have summoning sickness). The two 1/1 prowess tokens don't have haste and can't attack this turn anyway. Casting precombat uses 4 of 5 mana, leaving only 1 mana open during combat instead of having access to Blindblast (which could draw a card targeting an opponent's creature) or other tricks.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Goblin Wizardry in precombat main phase, using 4 mana before combat.
annotations.betterLine: Attack first with Pyroclastic Elemental (5/4) and Chandra's Magmutt (2/2) for 7 unblockable damage (opponent goes to 8), keeping all 5 mana open for combat tricks like Blindblast. Then cast Goblin Wizardry postcombat. The tokens can't attack this turn regardless of when they're created.

annotations.description: Passed priority in precombat main without playing a Forest. With Rampaging Baloths and Garruk's Uprising on the battlefield, playing a Forest would create a 4/4 Beast token and draw a card for free. While lethal was already on board (18 power vs 16 life with no available blockers), skipping the land drop wastes free value that could matter if something unexpected happens in combat.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without playing a land or casting any spells in precombat main phase.
annotations.betterLine: Play a Forest to trigger Rampaging Baloths (create 4/4 Beast token) and Garruk's Uprising (draw a card), then move to combat and attack for lethal.
